about.title: About Me
about.subtitle: Backend & Security Engineer focused on systems that are secure, observable and easy to maintain
about.description1: I'm a Backend & Security Engineer based in Entre Ríos, Argentina, working remotely. At Goalkeeper.com (TLA Studios, UK) I work on a performance-analytics platform used by professional football clubs: I built a multi-brand data warehouse on AWS, improve data integrity and audit trails across the platform, and add observability to the core API.
about.description2: Before that, as a freelance full-stack developer at R8 Audio, I built features end to end with NestJS and React and led the platform's migration from GCP to AWS and Cloudflare with Terraform and Docker.
about.description3: My background in IT support and security means I care about what happens after the deploy. I'm a Software Analysis and Development Technician (2025), I speak English at a B2 level, and I'm open to freelance projects.
